about.aboutDesc: Joseph Speciality Hospital is a multi-speciality healthcare institution in Srivilliputhur, committed to delivering quality medical services with a human touch. Our team of experienced specialists, modern facilities, and patient-centric approach make us a trusted choice for families across the region.
about.missionText: To provide accessible, affordable, and high-quality healthcare to every patient with dignity and compassion.
about.visionText: To be the most trusted healthcare provider in the region, recognised for clinical excellence and ethical care.

aboutPage.subtitle: Compassionate care and clinical excellence at the heart of Srivilliputhur.
aboutPage.overviewP1: Joseph Speciality Hospital is a multi-speciality healthcare institution located in Ramakrishnapuram, Mangapuram, Srivilliputhur, Tamil Nadu – 626125. For over two decades, we have been a trusted healthcare destination for families across Srivilliputhur and the surrounding regions of Virudhunagar district.
aboutPage.overviewP2: What began as a small clinic has grown into a comprehensive hospital offering 16 specialised departments, modern diagnostic facilities, a 24×7 emergency wing, and a team of over 40 experienced doctors. Yet our core philosophy has never changed — to provide quality healthcare with genuine compassion.
aboutPage.overviewP3: We believe healthcare is not just about treating illness, but about building lasting relationships with our patients and our community. Every person who walks through our doors is treated with dignity, listened to, and cared for as one of our own.
aboutPage.valuesSubtitle: These core values shape every decision we make and every patient we serve.
aboutPage.compassionText: We treat every patient with empathy, kindness, and respect.
aboutPage.integrityText: We uphold the highest ethical standards in all we do.

faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about visiting Joseph Speciality Hospital.
faq.q1: What are the OPD timings at Joseph Speciality Hospital?
faq.a1: The Outpatient Department operates Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Emergency services are available 24×7, every day of the week.
faq.q2: How can I book an appointment?
faq.a2: You can book an appointment online through our website's appointment page, by calling +91 4563 263000, or by visiting the hospital reception directly.
faq.a3: Yes, we accept most major health insurance and cashless treatment policies. Please contact our billing desk with your insurance details for confirmation.
faq.q4: Is there an ambulance service available?
faq.a4: Yes, we provide 24×7 ambulance service with trained paramedics. Call our emergency number to request an ambulance.
faq.a5: We accept cash, debit and credit cards, UPI, net banking, and digital wallets across all hospital counters.
faq.q6: Do you have a pharmacy on-site?
faq.a6: Yes, our in-house pharmacy is stocked with genuine medicines and is open during OPD hours for patient convenience.
